description: Projects always follow the latest version of their kits: the studio updates them automatically when a project is opened. Use this to do it now. Dry-run by default: returns the plan (from / to version, migrations). Pass apply=true to apply it. A migration with auto=false is never applied by itself: it is your task — apply its note (config, data) then call again. Omit id to check every installed kit. 0 credits.

apply.description: true to apply the update to the latest version (automatic migrations run). Default false = plan only.

id.description: Installed kit to update. Omit to check every installed kit.

project_id.description: Game Kit project id (gkp_…). Not a dedicated-server project (gpj_…) nor a Library item.

workspace_id.description: Workspace authorized by the current key. Never infer another user’s workspace.

name: gripforge_gamekit_update
title: Bring Game Kits to their latest version
